name: wikisource-wordcount
description: Deterministic word count for Wikisource works transcluded from scan pages (CLI, web page, and Wikisource gadget)

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js && esbuild src/web.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/web.js && esbuild src/gadget.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/gadget.js
